answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the walnut is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The mirror is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the hollow. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
